title: Orthogonality of Defect Ideals for Jordan Homomorphisms
summary: Let $\varphi\colon A\to B$ be a Jordan homomorphism of associative algebras over a field $\mathbb{F}$ of characteristic different from $2$, with defect ideals $V_{\varphi}$ and $W_{\varphi}$. If $A=\operatorname{Alg}([[A,A],[A,A]])$, then $V_{\varphi}W_{\varphi}=W_{\varphi}V_{\varphi}=0$ and $V_{\varphi}\cap W_{\varphi}\subseteq\operatorname{Ann}(\operatorname{Alg}(\varphi(A)))$. Moreover, the induced map modulo $V_{\varphi}\cap W_{\varphi}$ is standard. The annihilator bound is sharp, even in finite dimension.
